name: Pertamina PrimaXP
description: High-performance lubricants engineered for ultimate engine protection.
story: Pertamina PrimaXP is Indonesia's leading lubricant brand, committed to supporting national motorsport talent and technological advancement. We view motorsport as a proving ground for our products, demonstrating their reliability and performance under extreme conditions. Our partnership aims to elevate Indonesian motorsport and showcase our commitment to innovation on a global stage.
